summary: DOSBox-X 2026.05.02 Vga save blob layout for Wiz6 mode-0x0D (320x200 EGA 16-color). VRAM (vga.mem.linear) starts at blob offset 0x84000, NOT 0x80000 as previously claimed. 0x80000–0x83FFF is the VGA register/state dump (CRTC at 0x82F8C, AC regs at 0x82FC2, DAC at 0x82FE9, EGA lookup tables through 0x83FFF). Pixel pipeline: raw_index → AC_REGS[raw_index] → DAC[dac_entry] → RGB (NOT EGA_DEFAULT directly). Confirmed by decoding save 1 (CHARACTER MENU), save 2 (title art), save 8 (MASTER OPTIONS menu) — all produce recognisable clean screens with no masking. ~170 invariant DOSBox-internal-state bytes land inside vga.mem.linear at VGA addresses 621–646 (rows 15–16) and scattered positions in rows 18–23, 49–54, 121–131, producing ~161 noise pixels (< 0.3% of screen). No masking applied; disclosed here.

findings.claim: VGA VRAM (vga.mem.linear) starts at blob offset 0x84000 in every captured save state. The range 0x80000–0x83FFF is the VGA register/state dump, NOT VRAM.

blob_layout.0x000000-0x07FFFF: mostly-zero VGA state header (512 KB, < 0.1% non-zero)
blob_layout.0x080000-0x083FFF: VGA register state dump: CRTC at 0x82F8C, AC regs at 0x82FC2, DAC at 0x82FE9 (768 bytes), EGA lookup tables through 0x83FFF

evidence.validation: base=0x84000 decodes save 1 (CHARACTER MENU) showing gray background, blue frames, white menu-option text (1224 white pixels in bottom 40 rows). Save 2 (title art) shows 'Bane of the Cosmic Forge' characters. Save 8 (MASTER OPTIONS) shows ADD PARTY MEMBER / RESUME SAVED GAME / CHARACTER MENU / QUIT text.
evidence.prior_error: Earlier analysis used base=0x80000 and masked rows 27-36 and 75-90 as 'contamination'. Those masked ranges were entirely within the VGA state dump (0x80000-0x83FFF), not within actual VRAM. The masking made all-zero VRAM decode as all-black, which superficially passed color-distribution checks but produced no real game content.

findings.claim: VGA VRAM is stored as 4-plane interleaved: for VGA address A and plane P, the byte is at blob[0x84000 + A*4 + P].

evidence.observable: Decoding with interleaved formula at base 0x84000 produces correct structured game screens. Planar layout (separate 64KB planes) produces noise.
evidence.stride: 40 bytes/plane/row × 8 bits/byte = 320 pixels/row, confirmed by CRTC offset reg 0x13 = 0x14 = 20 → row stride 40

findings.claim: CRTC display-start address = 0 (registers 0x0C/0x0D both = 0x00) in all captured saves. No page flipping at any captured game state.
CRTC offset register (reg 0x13) = 0x14 = 20 → row stride = 40 bytes per row per plane. Correct for 320-pixel-wide mode 0x0D.
DAC palette is at blob offset 0x82FE9, 768 bytes (256 entries × 3 channels × 6-bit values). Entries 0–15 match BIOS-default EGA (same as EGA_DEFAULT when scaled to 8-bit).

evidence.method: direct read from blob across all saves
evidence.note: DAC[0..15] matches EGA_DEFAULT[0..15] exactly (confirmed by dosbox_identify_palette). However, pixels do NOT render via DAC[raw_index] directly — they go through AC register remapping first. See palette-pipeline finding.

findings.claim: Pixel→RGB uses AC→DAC composed pipeline, NOT EGA_DEFAULT[raw_index] directly. AC_REGS = [23,17,21,20,22,18,19,16, 7,1,5,4,6,2,3,0] (invariant across all saves, blob 0x82FC2). Pipeline: raw_index → AC_REGS[raw_index] → DAC[dac_entry] → 8-bit RGB.

evidence.why_not_ega_default: EGA_DEFAULT[0]=(0,0,0) black but actual pixel-0 renders as white. dosbox_identify_palette reports 'distance 0 to ega-default' because it measures DAC[0..15] directly (before AC), not the rendered pixel colors. The AC remapping inverts the luminance ordering relative to EGA_DEFAULT.

findings.claim: DOSBox-X writes ~170 internal-state bytes into vga.mem.linear at VGA addresses 621–646 (screen rows 15–16, right-side columns 21–46) and scattered positions (rows 18–23 col 22, 34, 38–39; rows 49–54 col 19,30–31; rows 121–131 col 34). These produce ~161 noise pixels (< 0.3% of screen). They are invariant across all captured saves.

evidence.example: VGA addr 630 (row 15 col_byte 30): bytes (03,04,05,06) = sequential counter values, not pixel data
evidence.decision: Not masked — visual impact is negligible and the base is confirmed correct. Masking was removed (previous code masked 0x0810E0-0x08171F and 0x82F70-0x838CE, which were in the VGA state region, not true VRAM).

decode_parameters.contamination_masking: NONE — removed; previous masking addressed wrong-base symptom, not the root cause

validation_save1.content_visible: Gray background, blue double-line frames, white interior boxes, 6 white menu options at bottom (PORTRAIT / EXIT / CREATE PC / REVIEW PC / DELETE PC / RENAME PC)

validation_save2.note: High noise due to dithered title art ('Bane of the Cosmic Forge' characters + stone wall). Normal for graphical screens.

validation_save8.content_visible: MASTER OPTIONS menu: ADD PARTY MEMBER, RESUME SAVED GAME, CHARACTER MENU, TITLE PAGE, SHOW GAME, QUIT
